stale_reason: Stale at M4A's reopening for M4A-12 (2026-11-15, wave4/a11y): a11y.py, linuxsession.py and presence.py changed, later merges changed ROADMAP.md, pyproject.toml, macnative.py and wave 4's scripts, and the plan gained a requirement; the R10- receipts re-ran its check on the changed files

receipts.method: Requirements review for the reopening (readiness.md): M4A-12 from the wayland worker's finding, at-spi2-core 2.62's D-Bus API as observed in WSL and its NEWS, checked for coverage, conflicts (IsEnabled alone not counted), failure behavior, non-blocking, ownership and its effect on the closed tasks.

M4A's tests on this Windows 11 workstation (offscreen Qt, the shared venv, PyQt6 6.11) at 5c6093e: 65 passed, 38 skipped, every skip with its reason (the other platforms' end-to-end tests, and Qt's contrast signal, which 6.11 wraps as a method). tests/test_screen_readers.py checks each Linux source with real D-Bus messages and /proc as a folder; the UI Automation client test ran, with comtypes 1.5.0.
The whole suite on Windows at 5c6093e: 1256 passed, 178 skipped, exit 0.

M4A's tests in WSL (Arch: at-spi2-core 2.62.1, Orca 51.1, PyQt6 6.12.1 in /var/tmp/m4a-venv) under xvfb-run -a, on the worktree's files at 5c6093e: 78 passed, 25 skipped (the other platforms'). Among them, on private session buses: at-spi2-core's own launcher with a reader's process starting as IsEnabled turns on (the launcher never started by asking), a pretend launcher before 2.62, GNOME's setting through gsettings on a keyfile, Orca's remote controller coming and going, and the portal, notification servers and UPower tests.

The real-sway screen-reader tests in WSL (/var/tmp/wayland-venv, PyQt6 6.11) at 5c6093e, with the real Orca 51.1 and at-spi2-core 2.62.1: 7 passed, 0 skipped. Chatmon, started before the reader's remote controller comes up, finds Orca and speaks through it, and moves the ask box to a window (screen_reader_changed).
